input_digests.reading: digests of the working-tree bytes as they were read here; a checkout that applies a different newline policy would reproduce the content and not the digests, which is why the verifier re-hashes the evidence itself rather than trusting these

ledger_contract.reading: the eighty-four historical entries keep the vocabulary they had; RFC-047 adds one block beside those fields and rewrites none of them
ledger_contract.readings: the entries differ from one another where the evidence differs, which is what a version-1 ledger does; the extension added by RFC-047 is what has to be identical in all eighty-four of them

purpose: join the ledger's record of every declared slot with the external record Windows produces for it, and state which of the two can be believed about what
reading: no slot is called corroborated without a record of this host behind it, no slot of this period can be called corroborated at all while the channel that would produce such a record is disabled and has never recorded, and every slot that is unobservable says so in its own state rather than being counted as attended or as missed
